manifest: axona pub/sub soak — WATCH-ONLY measurement contract (v2)
authority: Amends 5909ffe after the pull false-credit correction (65eca48). Written to Aster's re-freeze spec (c0cc2f8f); ratified direction Orion 0d859416, Vega 30c76ae5. Approves MEASUREMENT only — Gates 4/6 remain David's.
whyAmended: Under 5909ffe, delivery was credited when a routed peer.pull showed the ROOT held a message. The root holding a message is not the subscriber receiving it — the pull reads the wrong node, and the false credit scaled with sweep frequency (18 points at 10s). All 5909ffe completeness numbers, including the 97.9% baseline, are INVALID as end-to-end delivery evidence. This contract makes subscriber-local receipt the sole delivery event.

deliveryEvent.sole: a message is delivered to a required reader IF AND ONLY IF that reader's subscription callback received it (led.observe via 'watch'). Root possession, pull-head reads, and any routed read are NOT delivery. There is no pull channel.
deliveryEvent.paths: the watch callback fires for BOTH the root's live fanout push AND a renewal replay (since:'all' re-subscribe). Both count as delivery; they differ only in latency.

identifiers.trial: (confirmed publish msgId, required reader) — one trial per pair. requiredReaders come from the seeded plan, never from who answered.
identifiers.message: origin api-confirm msgId, preserved across every path; a reader's arrival matches a trial by msgId equality.
identifiers.reader: peerIdx from the seeded plan (stable across the run).

denominator: confirmed publishes (api.confirmed===true with an assigned msgId). Intent without api-confirm never enters the trial set.

classification.exactlyOnce: each (trial, reader) is live | repair | missing at the deadline
classification.live: first watch arrival within LIVE_WINDOW_MS of api-confirm — the forward fanout push
classification.repair: first watch arrival later than LIVE_WINDOW_MS but within MISSING_DEADLINE_MS — delivery that waited for a renewal cycle

renewalReplayClassification: a renewal replay arrives through the SAME watch callback as a live push; it is distinguished only by latency (it is late, so it lands in 'repair'). It is NOT a separate observe channel and NOT inferred from any root read.

duplication.realDuplicate: same msgId delivered to a reader MORE THAN ONCE via watch (W>1). Reported as an excess-arrival count, never folded into delivered.
duplication.note: with the pull removed there is no sampler re-read; watch+pull path-pairs no longer occur. Any excess is now a genuine multi-delivery.

bounds.MISSING_DEADLINE_basis: 2 x RENEW_MS (60s steady ceiling), the recovery-plane ceiling
bounds.MIGRATION_GAP_SLO_basis: Orion 62512171: pass/fail SLO for delivery under an active root transition, distinct from the completeness deadline
bounds.LIVE_WINDOW_basis: RENEW_FAST — a delivery beyond one fast-renewal interval waited for a renewal cycle, so it is recovery (repair), not the forward push. Predeclared before any run under this contract.

latency.anchor: origin api-confirm (confirmed msgId) to first WATCH delivery, per message
latency.perClass: p50/p95/p99 and count for live and repair separately; cold and converged phases apart
latency.clock: per-host wall corrected by calibration offsets; monotonic only within a process

localHeadSampling.behavior: the sidecar head-sweep and final drain read the subscriber's LOCAL head (m.lastSeqSeen / m.lastMsgId, tracked in the watch callback) and emit led.head from it. NO peer.pull, zero routed load, so the sweep cadence does not perturb the run. led.head feeds split-root detection (two readers' local heads compared).
localHeadSampling.cadence: HEAD_SWEEP_MS default 60000; because the read is local it may be lowered without an observer effect.

watchCollectorIntegrity.lossHandling: every watch callback appends one led.observe(via:'watch') synchronously; a write failure is a dropped observation and would UNDER-count delivery (bias toward more 'missing'), never over-count. The ledger is append-only JSONL; a torn final line is skipped by the analyzer's per-line try/catch.
watchCollectorIntegrity.overflow: the subscription's own ring is the kernel's; a ring eviction before the callback fires is a genuine non-delivery to the app and is correctly counted missing.

segmentation: each trial tagged by root migration, subscriber reattachment, dead-peer skip, and terminal-verify outcome, from relay-side + sidecar disc (LAT_TRACE). Migration tail cut separately.

immutableHashes.note: each run's runmanifest stamps these at start; recorded here for the contract baseline.

historicalArmsRecomputed.note: recomputed under watch-only where raw callback ledgers exist; the pull-based figures are retired.
historicalArmsRecomputed.comparability: these cross seed, duration, and time window — DIRECTIONAL only. They support the successor-density hypothesis (kNear=10 88.6% vs kNear=5 67.5% at matched 10s) but do NOT establish a causal benefit. Any arm without raw callback evidence is marked non-comparable, not estimated.

confirmatoryABMatrix.design: contemporaneous alternating kNear=5 vs kNear=10 at IDENTICAL 60s cadence and load, same seed/topic-set/relay-set/churn/deadlines, with a drift-repeat arm to expose time variation
confirmatoryABMatrix.preDeclaredPass: NON-INFERIORITY on completeness AND on live p95/p99 — a lower local-min rate or median alone is not a pass
confirmatoryABMatrix.reports: completeness by class, live/repair p50/p95/p99, migration-gap SLO, real-duplicate rate, terminal-verify (lookupOutcome + finalVerifyState), capacity, and the load metrics Aster named (pull RPCs are now zero; report connection/queue pressure where kernel counters allow)
confirmatoryABMatrix.gate: David's — this contract approves measurement, not the run
